description: A theme's skin: how the desktop apps draw their own widgets, over or in place of libadwaita's look. The phone draws the theme's colours and its own shapes.

css.description: Whether it has theme.css: GTK CSS drawn over all of the desktop apps' own.

gtk_theme.description: A GTK theme it draws with in place of libadwaita's stylesheet (Windows XP's, Windows 95's: the apps' GTK_THEME), by its name, as the folder gtk/<name>/ in the theme has it, or as one installed on the machine. Taken as an app starts.
